pages.overview.title: Overview
pages.bills.title: Bills
pages.bills.summary: {month} · {transactions} transactions · {anomalies} anomalies · Booked spending {total} (excluding investment flows)
pages.bills.emptyDescription: There are no transactions in the selected month. Select another month to view its records.
pages.cards.title: Cards
pages.cards.demoDescription: Cards are simulated records. Adding or deleting a card requires your confirmation and a verification code on this page.
pages.cards.addDescription: A masked demo card number is generated automatically. This does not issue a real bank card.
pages.cards.deleteDescription: Delete this simulated card record? This does not close a real account. Existing transaction and audit records are retained.
pages.cards.confirmDetails: I have checked and confirm this change.
pages.cards.verificationHint: Enter the demo verification code. This project does not send real text messages.
pages.cards.failed: The request could not be completed. Check your connection and retry the same change.
pages.cards.validation: Enter a valid amount with at most two decimal places. The credit limit must be greater than zero.
pages.cards.conflict: The card state has changed or has unfinished business. Refresh and check the card before retrying.
pages.cards.locked: Verification is locked. Wait for the lock to expire or use the developer reset in Security.
pages.cards.refreshFailed: Could not refresh cards or unfinished changes. Retry refresh before making another change.
pages.cards.emptyDescription: Use Add demo card to create a simulated debit, credit or virtual card.
pages.cards.consumeUnavailable: This card cannot be used for spending
pages.cards.creditConsumeUnsupported: Simulated credit-card spending is not supported
pages.subscriptions.title: Subscriptions
pages.subscriptions.summary: {count} active subscriptions · Fees and renewal dates
pages.subscriptions.annualDescription: Annualized spending based on the billing cycle
pages.subscriptions.emptyDescription: There are no active subscriptions. New subscription records will appear here.
pages.subscriptions.listDescription: Name / fee / billing cycle / next charge
pages.subscriptions.footer: The assistant requests confirmation before cancelling subscriptions or changing reminders.
pages.audit.title: Audit log
pages.activity.title: Operation history
pages.activity.summary: Latest {count} records · Status at the time of each record
pages.activity.emptyDescription: Transfers, card changes and other banking requests are recorded here as they progress.
pages.audit.detailDescription: Newest first · One entry for each risk decision and authorized execution
pages.audit.emptyDescription: Tool calls and risk decisions will appear here after a conversation with the assistant in this session.
pages.security.title: Security
pages.security.unlockDescription: High-risk operations remain locked after repeated verification failures.
pages.contacts.title: Contacts
pages.contacts.name: Name
pages.contacts.deleteDescription: This removes the saved recipient. Existing transfers and audit entries are preserved.
pages.contacts.emptyDescription: Add a recipient using their name and mobile number.
pages.contacts.validation: Enter a name and an 11-digit mainland China mobile number.
pages.contacts.duplicate: This mobile number is already saved. Check the contact list.
pages.contacts.failed: The contact could not be saved. Refresh and try again.
pages.contacts.deleteFailed: The contact could not be deleted. Refresh and try again.
pages.investments.title: Investments
pages.investments.description: Expected returns are estimates. Purchases and redemptions require confirmation and verification in the conversation.
pages.investments.emptyDescription: Ask the assistant to compare products before purchasing.
